reference:
The Quick Fuck is described as a layered shooter made from one part coffee liqueur, one part cold Midori liqueur, and one part Baileys Irish Cream, with each layer carefully poured to float on top of the previous one. In contrast, Ti' Punch is a rum-based mixed drink similar to a daiquiri, typically made with rum, lime juice, and sugar, with no mention of a layering process.

FINDING: Quick Fuck has multiple layers; Ti' Punch does not.
